about: seq-events 0.1 for Digitone OS 1.44, the build MUTINY's author made from Dracyr's source and tested MUTINY with, pinned unchanged. Source in sdk/digitone/dependencies/seq-events.

mods.title: seq events
mods.summary: Step-fire events for the Digitone mk1, so several mods that change what the sequencer plays can combine. On its own it changes nothing the unit does.
mods.description: The Digitone mk1's step fire as events, so several mods that change what the sequencer plays combine: generators (does an audio track's step fire; which notes it plays) and effects over what every fire plays, audio and MIDI tracks (the step it reads, the trig, its condition, notes, velocity and locks), a step clock per track, and the active pattern's facts when asked (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Step-fire events"). On its own it changes nothing the unit does.
mods.author: Dracyr
mods.on_unit: Ran under MUTINY on one Digitone mk1, OS 1.44, for about an hour. Not tested on its own or with other mods on hardware.
